title: Echelon System Manifest v2
description: Manifest v1 plus an optional provenance descriptor (spec/provenance-propagation.md, REG-PROV-012..REG-PROV-014). The descriptor declares transport support for the Praxis interchange contract; it does not define identity semantics. An absent descriptor means `undeclared`, which MUST NOT be read as preserving provenance.

systemId.description: Registry id. It is also the <system> segment of Praxis EXT-<system>.<run-id> keys, so it has no dots. `run` and `op` are reserved pseudo-systems used by the envelope v1 mapping (EXT-run.<runId>, EXT-op.<operationId>) and can never be registered (REG-PROV-011).

interchange.description: Praxis interchange majors the system understands (verdict `supported`). Any other major is carried verbatim by a conforming consumer or transport.

envelopes.description: Execution envelope versions the system accepts. Absent means only echelon.execution-envelope/v1 may be assumed.

roles.description: producer: emits blocks for records it owns; consumer: receives blocks and stores them with its records; transport: forwards blocks to other systems.

actor.description: Keeps the invoking actor of a request.

unknownFields.description: `preserve` is required for conformance with praxis.provenance/1; `discard` declares a lossy receiver that callers MUST treat as not preserving provenance.

recordsTransformation.description: Whether the system appends its own `transformed` contribution (automation echelon/<id>, key EXT-<id>.<operationId>) when it changes a record's representation. Absent means not declared.
